metadata.title: iFan.asia — Business Management Platform
metadata.description: Never let a customer message go unanswered. Zalo inbox, CRM, tasks, inventory, finance, and AI that actually works — built for Vietnamese SMEs.

landing.headline: Never let a customer message go unanswered.
landing.subheadline: iFan.asia — the business management platform for Vietnamese SMEs: a unified Zalo inbox, CRM, tasks, inventory, finance, and AI that actually works for you.
